concept: Square Drop: a new interactive delivery-first brand experience. Only the existing 90pizza logo and brand geometry are reused. Light product-launch poster, a physical hinged 3D box, a dark flavor studio, nine-slice interaction, and an acid-green delivery route.

Thin crisp golden artisan crust only around the outer perimeter, rich red tomato sauce, irregular melted mozzarella, realistically cupped deep-red pepperoni with tiny pools of oil, fine oregano, a few very small chili flecks. Premium appetizing editorial photography, natural imperfect topping placement. Different from a generic pizza catalog photo. Uncut continuous cheese surface; absolutely no slice lines or grid. No letters, numbers, branding, logo, watermark. The image will be texture-mapped to a three-dimensional pizza so exact top-down alignment is essential. No illustration, no toy-like rendering.
